name: ServiceTitan
summary: A large service and project management platform whose estimates tie to one pricebook.
differentiator: Its own estimating page says plan takeoff happens in other tools (it names McCormick, Conest and Trimble Accubid) and offers to import their output. Estimates are Good-Better-Best proposals, line-item estimates and project estimates tied to one pricebook.
pricing: Quote only. Plans are named Starter, Essentials and The Works, priced per technician, and each has a "Request Pricing" button.

scope.takeoff: None. The page says contractors use dedicated takeoff tools and import the results, or work from spreadsheets.
scope.library: A pricebook that the page says "pulls from industry supplier catalogs".
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: The pricebook pulls from supplier catalogs, in the vendor's words. What that feed costs is not stated.

bestFor: Shops that run service and project work together and want estimates, dispatch, invoicing and accounting in one system.
skipIf: You mainly bid commercial plans and need takeoff inside the same tool.
watchOut: Its electrical estimating guide is vendor content that presents ServiceTitan as the all-in-one answer.
The statistics it quotes (such as a 16% average revenue increase) are the vendor's own.
